channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Chipotle: National Avocado Day: Free Chips and Guac with Entree
item.guid: Chipotle-National Avocado Day: Free Chips and Gua-2026-08-01
item.description: Use code AVO2026 at checkout on the Chipotle app or chipotle.com with any full-priced entree purchase to get a free regular side of chips and guacamole — today is the last day. Free Chipotle account required for digital orders. (August 1, 2026)

item.title: Del Taco: National Avocado Day BOGO: Epic Fresh Guac Burrito
item.guid: Del Taco-National Avocado Day BOGO: Epic Fresh Gu-2026-08-01
item.description: Buy one Epic Fresh Guac Burrito and get a second one free in celebration of National Avocado Day — valid July 31 through August 2. (August 2, 2026)

item.title: Shake Shack: Any Frozen Custard for $3 with Code CUSTARDTIME
item.guid: Shake Shack-Any Frozen Custard for $3 with Code CUST-2026-08-01
item.description: Use promo code CUSTARDTIME at an in-restaurant kiosk, on the Shake Shack website, or in the app to get any frozen custard for just $3 through August 19. (August 19, 2026)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Get three pieces of signature chicken, three tenders, two sides, or a chicken sandwich for just $5 through the end of August at participating locations. (August 31, 2026)

item.title: Subway: Buy One Footlong, Get One Free
item.guid: Subway-Buy One Footlong, Get One Free-2026-08-01
item.description: Subway is running a limited-time BOGO free offer on Footlong Subs — check the app or subway.com for the current offer and any applicable code at checkout. (Limited time)

item.title: Denny's: Slammin' Meal Deals Starting at $5.99
item.description: Denny's everyday Slammin' Meal Deals menu offers full breakfast and comfort-food entrees starting at $5.99 at participating locations — no app or code required. (Ongoing)

item.title: Sonic: $1.99 Everyday Value Menu
item.description: Sonic's $1.99 Menu features items like the Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger and Chicken Wrap available every day at participating drive-ins — no code needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Sweetgreen: Alice Waters' Peach & Goat Cheese Salad
item.description: Limited-edition summer collab with chef Alice Waters - a seasonal peach & goat cheese salad available nationwide in-app and in stores, with 1% of proceeds donated to the Edible Schoolyard Project. (Through August 10, 2026)
